registryBasis: The official Patna tehsil page explicitly lists Bakhtiyarpur as a revenue circle and explains its Circle Officer/DCLR system. The Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms directory separately lists Circle Officer, Bakhtiyarpur. This is first-party city-local revenue-record evidence; the municipality-branded .net portal remains supplementary discovery evidence, with its operator independently unverified. No anonymous cadastral polygon response was verified.
